name: Simulated Ledger Health
svgcontent:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1280" height="720" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
<rect id="BACKGROUND" x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" rx="0" ry="0" fill="#F4F7FA" stroke="#F4F7FA" stroke-width="1"/>
<rect id="HEADER" x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="105" rx="0" ry="0" fill="#102A43" stroke="#102A43" stroke-width="1"/>
<text id="TITLE" x="55" y="48" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="start">Simulated Blockchain Ledger Health</text>
<text id="SUBTITLE" x="55" y="79" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#D9EAF7" text-anchor="start">Supply-chain provenance, QMS decisions and SHA-256 hash-chain evidence</text>
<rect id="STATE_CARD" x="55" y="135" width="350" height="145" rx="12" ry="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9E2EC" stroke-width="1"/>
<text id="STATE_LABEL" x="85" y="177" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#627D98" text-anchor="start">LEDGER STATE</text>
<text id="STATE_VALUE" x="85" y="235" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="700" fill="#18A558" text-anchor="start">VALID</text>
<rect id="BLOCK_CARD" x="465" y="135" width="350" height="145" rx="12" ry="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9E2EC" stroke-width="1"/>
<text id="BLOCK_LABEL" x="495" y="177" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#627D98" text-anchor="start">BLOCK COUNT</text>
<text id="BLOCK_VALUE" x="495" y="235" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="34" font-weight="700" fill="#102A43" text-anchor="start">6</text>
<rect id="HASH_CARD" x="875" y="135" width="350" height="145" rx="12" ry="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9E2EC" stroke-width="1"/>
<text id="HASH_LABEL" x="905" y="177" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#627D98" text-anchor="start">LATEST BLOCK HASH</text>
<text id="HASH_VALUE" x="905" y="232" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#102A43" text-anchor="start">8709fd150f5bc451...</text>
<rect id="APPROVED_CARD" x="55" y="315" width="350" height="145" rx="12" ry="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9E2EC" stroke-width="1"/>
<text id="APPROVED_LABEL" x="85" y="357" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#627D98" text-anchor="start">APPROVED FOR USE</text>
<text id="APPROVED_VALUE" x="85" y="417" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="34" font-weight="700" fill="#18A558" text-anchor="start">2</text>
<rect id="QUARANTINE_CARD" x="465" y="315" width="350" height="145" rx="12" ry="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9E2EC" stroke-width="1"/>
<text id="QUARANTINE_LABEL" x="495" y="357" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#627D98" text-anchor="start">QUARANTINED</text>
<text id="QUARANTINE_VALUE" x="495" y="417" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="34" font-weight="700" fill="#E59B18" text-anchor="start">1</text>
<rect id="REJECTED_CARD" x="875" y="315" width="350" height="145" rx="12" ry="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9E2EC" stroke-width="1"/>
<text id="REJECTED_LABEL" x="905" y="357" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#627D98" text-anchor="start">REJECTED / LEGAL REVIEW</text>
<text id="REJECTED_VALUE" x="905" y="417" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="34" font-weight="700" fill="#D64545" text-anchor="start">3</text>
<rect id="INTEGRITY_CARD" x="55" y="495" width="1170" height="155" rx="12" ry="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9E2EC" stroke-width="1"/>
<text id="INTEGRITY_TITLE" x="85" y="537" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#627D98" text-anchor="start">INTEGRITY VERIFICATION</text>
<text id="FAILURE_LABEL" x="85" y="588" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#102A43" text-anchor="start">Integrity Failure:</text>
<text id="FAILURE_VALUE" x="270" y="588" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#18A558" text-anchor="start">NO</text>
<text id="RECORD_LABEL" x="470" y="588" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#102A43" text-anchor="start">First Failing Record:</text>
<text id="RECORD_VALUE" x="675" y="588" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#102A43" text-anchor="start">N/A</text>
<text id="ALGORITHM_LABEL" x="875" y="588" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#102A43" text-anchor="start">Hash Algorithm:</text>
<text id="ALGORITHM_VALUE" x="1030" y="588" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#102A43" text-anchor="start">SHA-256</text>
<text id="FOOTER" x="55" y="690" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#627D98" text-anchor="start">Educational simulated blockchain — tamper-evident single-node hash chain</text>
</svg>
